description: Automatically derive Orion laps from GPS crossing a generated or saved start/finish gate.

links.title: Switch Orion Workbook
links.tooltip: Jump between Andrew Orion dashboards while keeping time range and variables.

options.content:
ORION GPS LAP BUILDER
Generate laps from GPS crossing a start/finish gate. Default Auto Gate uses the first valid GPS point; Track Mapping uses the saved gate from track_mapping.

panels.title: Generated Lap Sheet - Click Lap To Analyze
panels.description: Query-generated laps. Clicking lap opens the Orion overview with matching time bounds.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_partitions AS (
  SELECT p.start_time, p.end_time
  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
), run_points AS (
  SELECT p.time, p.packet_id, d.gps[1]::double precision AS lat, d.gps[2]::double precision AS lon,
         d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph
  FROM dynamics d JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = d.packet_id JOIN run_bounds ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN run_bounds.run_start AND run_bounds.run_end
    AND d.gps IS NOT NULL AND array_length(d.gps, 1) >= 2
    AND d.gps[1] BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND d.gps[2] BETWEEN -180 AND 180
), auto_seed AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT time, lat, lon,
           LEAD(lat, 10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS lat_next,
           LEAD(lon, 10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS lon_next
    FROM run_points
  ) seeded
  WHERE lat_next IS NOT NULL AND lon_next IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
), auto_gate AS (
  SELECT lat - ((lon_next - lon) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lat1,
         lon + ((lat_next - lat) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lon1,
         lat + ((lon_next - lon) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lat2,
         lon - ((lat_next - lat) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lon2,
         'auto first GPS point'::text AS gate_name
  FROM auto_seed
), mapped_gate AS (
  SELECT start_gate_lat1::double precision AS lat1, start_gate_lon1::double precision AS lon1,
         start_gate_lat2::double precision AS lat2, start_gate_lon2::double precision AS lon2,
         name AS gate_name
  FROM track_mapping
  WHERE track_mapping_id::text = NULLIF('${TrackMapping:raw}', '$__all')
  LIMIT 1
), gate AS (
  SELECT * FROM mapped_gate WHERE '${GateMode:raw}' = 'mapped'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM auto_gate WHERE '${GateMode:raw}' = 'auto' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mapped_gate)
  LIMIT 1
), segments AS (
  SELECT LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time, time,
         LAG(lat) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_lat, lat,
         LAG(lon) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_lon, lon
  FROM run_points
), raw_crossings AS (
  SELECT ((prev_time + time) / 2)::bigint AS crossing_time
  FROM segments CROSS JOIN gate
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
    AND LEAST(prev_lat, lat) <= GREATEST(gate.lat1, gate.lat2)
    AND GREATEST(prev_lat, lat) >= LEAST(gate.lat1, gate.lat2)
    AND LEAST(prev_lon, lon) <= GREATEST(gate.lon1, gate.lon2)
    AND GREATEST(prev_lon, lon) >= LEAST(gate.lon1, gate.lon2)
    AND (((lat - prev_lat) * (gate.lon1 - prev_lon) - (lon - prev_lon) * (gate.lat1 - prev_lat)) *
         ((lat - prev_lat) * (gate.lon2 - prev_lon) - (lon - prev_lon) * (gate.lat2 - prev_lat))) <= 0
    AND (((gate.lat2 - gate.lat1) * (prev_lon - gate.lon1) - (gate.lon2 - gate.lon1) * (prev_lat - gate.lat1)) *
         ((gate.lat2 - gate.lat1) * (lon - gate.lon1) - (gate.lon2 - gate.lon1) * (lat - gate.lat1))) <= 0
), crossing_gaps AS (
  SELECT crossing_time,
         CASE WHEN LAG(crossing_time) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) IS NULL
                OR crossing_time - LAG(crossing_time) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) > (${MinLapSeconds:raw}::int * 1000)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group
  FROM raw_crossings
), clustered_crossings AS (
  SELECT crossing_time, SUM(new_group) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) AS cluster_id
  FROM crossing_gaps
), lap_marks AS (
  SELECT MIN(crossing_time) AS start_time
  FROM clustered_crossings
  GROUP BY cluster_id
), generated_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS lap,
         start_time,
         LEAD(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS next_time
  FROM lap_marks
), lap_metrics AS (
  SELECT generated_laps.lap, generated_laps.start_time, generated_laps.next_time,
         (generated_laps.next_time - generated_laps.start_time) / 1000.0 AS lap_s,
         MAX(d.gps_speed * 2.23694) AS max_mph,
         AVG(c.apps1_travel) AS avg_throttle,
         MAX(c.brake_pressure_f) AS peak_brake_f
  FROM generated_laps
  LEFT JOIN packet p ON p.time >= generated_laps.start_time AND p.time < COALESCE(generated_laps.next_time, generated_laps.start_time + 120000)
  LEFT JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  WHERE generated_laps.next_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY generated_laps.lap, generated_laps.start_time, generated_laps.next_time
)
, ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MIN(lap_s) OVER () AS best_lap_s
  FROM lap_metrics
)
SELECT lap AS "lap",
       to_char(to_timestamp(start_time / 1000.0), 'HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS "start",
       ROUND(lap_s::numeric, 3) AS "lap time [s]",
       ROUND((lap_s - best_lap_s)::numeric, 3) AS "delta [s]",
       ROUND(max_mph::numeric, 1) AS "max [mph]",
       ROUND(avg_throttle::numeric, 1) AS "avg throttle [%]",
       ROUND(peak_brake_f::numeric, 1) AS "peak brake F [psi]",
       CONCAT(start_time, ':', next_time) AS lap_value,
       start_time AS start_ms,
       next_time AS end_ms
FROM ranked
ORDER BY lap;

  FROM partitions p
  WHERE ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[] @> ARRAY['$__all']::text[]
     OR p.partition_name = ANY(ARRAY[${Zoom:singlequote}]::text[])
), run_bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MIN(start_time), $__from::bigint), $__from::bigint) AS run_start,
         LEAST(COALESCE(MAX(end_time), $__to::bigint), $__to::bigint) AS run_end
  FROM selected_partitions
), granularity AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__interval_ms::double precision, 1) AS step_ms
), run_points AS (
  SELECT p.time, p.packet_id, d.gps[1]::double precision AS lat, d.gps[2]::double precision AS lon,
         d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph
  FROM dynamics d JOIN packet p ON p.packet_id = d.packet_id JOIN run_bounds ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN run_bounds.run_start AND run_bounds.run_end
    AND d.gps IS NOT NULL AND array_length(d.gps, 1) >= 2
    AND d.gps[1] BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND d.gps[2] BETWEEN -180 AND 180
), auto_seed AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT time, lat, lon,
           LEAD(lat, 10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS lat_next,
           LEAD(lon, 10) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS lon_next
    FROM run_points
  ) seeded
  WHERE lat_next IS NOT NULL AND lon_next IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY time LIMIT 1
), auto_gate AS (
  SELECT lat - ((lon_next - lon) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lat1,
         lon + ((lat_next - lat) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lon1,
         lat + ((lon_next - lon) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lat2,
         lon - ((lat_next - lat) / NULLIF(SQRT(POWER(lat_next - lat, 2) + POWER(lon_next - lon, 2)), 0)) * 0.00018 AS lon2,
         'auto first GPS point'::text AS gate_name
  FROM auto_seed
), mapped_gate AS (
  SELECT start_gate_lat1::double precision AS lat1, start_gate_lon1::double precision AS lon1,
         start_gate_lat2::double precision AS lat2, start_gate_lon2::double precision AS lon2,
         name AS gate_name
  FROM track_mapping
  WHERE track_mapping_id::text = NULLIF('${TrackMapping:raw}', '$__all')
  LIMIT 1
), gate AS (
  SELECT * FROM mapped_gate WHERE '${GateMode:raw}' = 'mapped'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM auto_gate WHERE '${GateMode:raw}' = 'auto' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mapped_gate)
  LIMIT 1
), segments AS (
  SELECT LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time, time,
         LAG(lat) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_lat, lat,
         LAG(lon) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_lon, lon
  FROM run_points
), raw_crossings AS (
  SELECT ((prev_time + time) / 2)::bigint AS crossing_time
  FROM segments CROSS JOIN gate
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
    AND LEAST(prev_lat, lat) <= GREATEST(gate.lat1, gate.lat2)
    AND GREATEST(prev_lat, lat) >= LEAST(gate.lat1, gate.lat2)
    AND LEAST(prev_lon, lon) <= GREATEST(gate.lon1, gate.lon2)
    AND GREATEST(prev_lon, lon) >= LEAST(gate.lon1, gate.lon2)
    AND (((lat - prev_lat) * (gate.lon1 - prev_lon) - (lon - prev_lon) * (gate.lat1 - prev_lat)) *
         ((lat - prev_lat) * (gate.lon2 - prev_lon) - (lon - prev_lon) * (gate.lat2 - prev_lat))) <= 0
    AND (((gate.lat2 - gate.lat1) * (prev_lon - gate.lon1) - (gate.lon2 - gate.lon1) * (prev_lat - gate.lat1)) *
         ((gate.lat2 - gate.lat1) * (lon - gate.lon1) - (gate.lon2 - gate.lon1) * (lat - gate.lat1))) <= 0
), crossing_gaps AS (
  SELECT crossing_time,
         CASE WHEN LAG(crossing_time) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) IS NULL
                OR crossing_time - LAG(crossing_time) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) > (${MinLapSeconds:raw}::int * 1000)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group
  FROM raw_crossings
), clustered_crossings AS (
  SELECT crossing_time, SUM(new_group) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) AS cluster_id
  FROM crossing_gaps
), lap_marks AS (
  SELECT MIN(crossing_time) AS start_time
  FROM clustered_crossings
  GROUP BY cluster_id
), generated_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS lap,
         start_time,
         LEAD(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS next_time
  FROM lap_marks
), lap_metrics AS (
  SELECT generated_laps.lap, generated_laps.start_time, generated_laps.next_time,
         (generated_laps.next_time - generated_laps.start_time) / 1000.0 AS lap_s,
         MAX(d.gps_speed * 2.23694) AS max_mph,
         AVG(c.apps1_travel) AS avg_throttle,
         MAX(c.brake_pressure_f) AS peak_brake_f
  FROM generated_laps
  LEFT JOIN packet p ON p.time >= generated_laps.start_time AND p.time < COALESCE(generated_laps.next_time, generated_laps.start_time + 120000)
  LEFT JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  WHERE generated_laps.next_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY generated_laps.lap, generated_laps.start_time, generated_laps.next_time
)
, speed_trace AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(p.time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time,
         AVG(d.gps_speed * 2.23694) AS "speed [mph]",
         AVG(c.apps1_travel) AS "throttle [%]",
         AVG(c.brake_pressure_f) AS "brake front [psi]"
  FROM packet p
  JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  JOIN run_bounds ON true JOIN granularity ON true
  WHERE p.time BETWEEN run_bounds.run_start AND run_bounds.run_end
  GROUP BY 1
), lap_pulses AS (
  SELECT to_timestamp(floor(start_time / granularity.step_ms) * granularity.step_ms / 1000.0) AS time, 100.0 AS "GPS lap crossing"
  FROM generated_laps CROSS JOIN granularity
)
SELECT speed_trace.time, speed_trace."speed [mph]", speed_trace."throttle [%]", speed_trace."brake front [psi]", lap_pulses."GPS lap crossing"
FROM speed_trace LEFT JOIN lap_pulses ON lap_pulses.time = speed_trace.time
ORDER BY speed_trace.time;

), run_points AS (

  SELECT start_gate_lat1::double precision AS lat1, start_gate_lon1::double precision AS lon1,
         start_gate_lat2::double precision AS lat2, start_gate_lon2::double precision AS lon2,
         name AS gate_name
  FROM track_mapping
  WHERE track_mapping_id::text = NULLIF('${TrackMapping:raw}', '$__all')
  LIMIT 1
), gate AS (
  SELECT * FROM mapped_gate WHERE '${GateMode:raw}' = 'mapped'
  UNION ALL

), segments AS (
  SELECT LAG(time) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_time, time,
         LAG(lat) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_lat, lat,
         LAG(lon) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev_lon, lon
  FROM run_points
), raw_crossings AS (
  SELECT ((prev_time + time) / 2)::bigint AS crossing_time
  FROM segments CROSS JOIN gate
  WHERE prev_time IS NOT NULL
    AND LEAST(prev_lat, lat) <= GREATEST(gate.lat1, gate.lat2)
    AND GREATEST(prev_lat, lat) >= LEAST(gate.lat1, gate.lat2)
    AND LEAST(prev_lon, lon) <= GREATEST(gate.lon1, gate.lon2)
    AND GREATEST(prev_lon, lon) >= LEAST(gate.lon1, gate.lon2)
    AND (((lat - prev_lat) * (gate.lon1 - prev_lon) - (lon - prev_lon) * (gate.lat1 - prev_lat)) *

  SELECT crossing_time,
         CASE WHEN LAG(crossing_time) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) IS NULL
                OR crossing_time - LAG(crossing_time) OVER (ORDER BY crossing_time) > (${MinLapSeconds:raw}::int * 1000)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group

), generated_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY start_time) AS lap,
         start_time,

  FROM lap_marks
), lap_metrics AS (
  SELECT generated_laps.lap, generated_laps.start_time, generated_laps.next_time,
         (generated_laps.next_time - generated_laps.start_time) / 1000.0 AS lap_s,
         MAX(d.gps_speed * 2.23694) AS max_mph,
         AVG(c.apps1_travel) AS avg_throttle,

  FROM generated_laps
  LEFT JOIN packet p ON p.time >= generated_laps.start_time AND p.time < COALESCE(generated_laps.next_time, generated_laps.start_time + 120000)
  LEFT JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  LEFT JOIN controls c ON c.packet_id = p.packet_id
  WHERE generated_laps.next_time IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY generated_laps.lap, generated_laps.start_time, generated_laps.next_time
)
, selected_laps AS (
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lap) AS compare_slot, lap, start_time, next_time
  FROM generated_laps
  WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL AND lap <= ${GpsCompareCount:raw}::int
), samples AS (
  SELECT sl.compare_slot, sl.lap, p.time,
         d.gps[1]::double precision AS lat, d.gps[2]::double precision AS lon,
         d.gps_speed * 2.23694 AS speed_mph,
         LAG(d.gps[1]::double precision) OVER (PARTITION BY sl.compare_slot ORDER BY p.time) AS prev_lat,
         LAG(d.gps[2]::double precision) OVER (PARTITION BY sl.compare_slot ORDER BY p.time) AS prev_lon
  FROM selected_laps sl
  JOIN packet p ON p.time >= sl.start_time AND p.time < sl.next_time
  JOIN dynamics d ON d.packet_id = p.packet_id
  WHERE d.gps IS NOT NULL AND array_length(d.gps, 1) >= 2
), distance_samples AS (
  SELECT *,
         SUM(CASE WHEN prev_lat IS NULL OR prev_lon IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE
           2 * 6371000 * ASIN(LEAST(1.0, SQRT(
             POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lat - prev_lat) / 2), 2) +
             COS(RADIANS(prev_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(lat)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(lon - prev_lon) / 2), 2)
           ))) END) OVER (PARTITION BY compare_slot ORDER BY time ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS distance_m
  FROM samples
), binned AS (
  SELECT (FLOOR(distance_m / GREATEST(${DistanceStep:raw}::numeric, 1)) * GREATEST(${DistanceStep:raw}::numeric, 1))::double precision AS distance_m,
         compare_slot,
         AVG(speed_mph) AS speed_mph
  FROM distance_samples
  GROUP BY 1, compare_slot
)
SELECT distance_m,
       AVG(speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE compare_slot = 1) AS "Compare 1 speed [mph]",
       AVG(speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE compare_slot = 2) AS "Compare 2 speed [mph]",
       AVG(speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE compare_slot = 3) AS "Compare 3 speed [mph]",
       AVG(speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE compare_slot = 4) AS "Compare 4 speed [mph]",
       AVG(speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE compare_slot = 5) AS "Compare 5 speed [mph]",
       AVG(speed_mph) FILTER (WHERE compare_slot = 6) AS "Compare 6 speed [mph]"
FROM binned
GROUP BY distance_m
ORDER BY distance_m;

SELECT track_mapping_id AS id, name, to_timestamp(created_at / 1000.0) AS created,
       ROUND(start_gate_lat1::numeric, 7) AS lat1, ROUND(start_gate_lon1::numeric, 7) AS lon1,
       ROUND(start_gate_lat2::numeric, 7) AS lat2, ROUND(start_gate_lon2::numeric, 7) AS lon2
FROM track_mapping
ORDER BY created_at DESC;

options.content: This workbook does not need pre-existing classifier lap rows. It detects each time the GPS segment between two packets intersects the selected start/finish gate, deduplicates crossings closer than ${MinLapSeconds}s, and builds lap intervals from crossing-to-crossing. Use Auto Gate for a first-pass lap split, then save a real gate in track_mapping and switch to Track Mapping for repeatable analysis.
